product_metadata.title: CEETBOON Kids Stainless Steel Leak-Resistant Lunch Box - Bento-Style 5 Compartments and Bonus Silicone Container for Meals On the Go Eco-Friendly BPA-Free Used for Adults Bento（Purple）
features: 【SAFE MATERIAL】 CEETBOON Bento box interior is made from the highest quality 304 stainless steel, this is the BPA free materials for packing healthy food to go.Food grade PP on exterior provide us healthy and safe.
【LEAK-PROOF DESIGN】The lid of salad lunch container is equipped with tight locks.Four-sided buckle is more sealed and leak-proof.
【5 COMPARTMENTS STORAGE】5 compartments can separate salad, snacks, fruits and other food. It is convenient for you to taste and mix them up as you want.
【EASY CLEAN 】CEETBOON lunch box is easy to clean, just take the metal tray out and wash it.

【PORTABLE SIZE】 Measuring Length: 10.62in Width: 7.87in Height: 2.75in, The size is convenient to carry for work, picnic, travel. It is available for you to put Stainless steel lunch box into your backpack.
description: CEETBOON Stainless Steel Leak-Resistant Lunch Box makes meal prepping and transporting healthy lunches on the go easy. Use the leakproof lunchbox and tray to transport your healthy meal and plan and store your next two meals. There are so many options for a balanced, stylish meal plan with the CEETBOON Stainless Steel Leak-Resistant Lunch Box.
